nodes.label: ADR-001: PII Encryption Strategy (AES-256 + SHA-256 Hash Columns)
nodes.rationale: Pure encryption blocks indexed lookup (email/phone login, uniqueness checks); bcrypt is too slow for lookups and can't be used in SQL WHERE clauses. Solution: dual-column strategy per PII field — AES-256-GCM `_enc` column for storage/decryption, deterministic SHA-256 `_hash` column for indexed equality lookup. Trade-off accepted: SHA-256 hashes of common emails are theoretically rainbow-table attackable, but hashes are only used for equality lookup and never exposed in API responses. Changing ENCRYPTION_KEY requires a full re-encryption migration (high-stakes event). Redis is forbidden from ever caching `*email*`, `*phone*`, `*password*` keys.
